support_evidence_summary: The evidence shows that Michael J. Hunter replaced Scott Pruitt as Attorney General of Oklahoma, and Scott Pruitt was confirmed as Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). The question asks about the agency whose administrator was replaced by Hunter, which is the EPA.
